REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE: - `validateBranchTypes(context)` reads `options[0].branchTypes` and: - Returns only supported types when valid. - On invalid types, returns a `Program` listener that reports config errors per invalid type with message `Value "${t}" should be equal to one of the allowed values: ${DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES.join(", ")}` (tested in `tests/rules/require-branch-annotation.test.ts`). -
